entities.name: Héctor Sánchez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Héctor Enrique Sánchez is a Venezuelan professional baseball catcher for the Caciques de Distrito of the Venezuelan Major League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the San Francisco Giants, Chicago White Sox, and San Diego Padres.
